The prompt appears because `resolveHosts` ignores `--dir`. When `--dir` is set, the target directory is already fixed, so the command should skip the agent prompt and use the default agent for the plan. I haven't compiled or run this change.

<<<< FILE: pkg/cmd/skills/install/install.go
<<<<<<< SEARCH
	if !canPrompt {
		h, err := registry.FindByID(registry.DefaultAgentID)
=======
	if opts.Dir != "" || !canPrompt {
		h, err := registry.FindByID(registry.DefaultAgentID)
>>>>>>> REPLACE

The agent prompt runs even when `--dir` is set, though `--dir` should override `--agent` and `--scope`. The fix is to skip the interactive agent selection when `opts.Dir` is set and fall back to the default host, which `buildInstallPlans` then ignores in favor of `opts.Dir`.
